item.description:
Release v5.6.1

Changes since v5.6.0

  • docs(GitPlugin): reference WorkspaceProviding in commit detail view
  • docs(plans): update session plan
  • feat(ActivityBar): add local highlight state and trace layout container activation
  • feat(ActivityBar): show error state when workspace is unavailable
  • feat(AskUserPlugin): make mode a required ask_user parameter
  • feat(AskUserPlugin): render free-text input for mode=free_text
  • feat(BrewManagerPlugin): add dedicated error view for brew operations
  • feat(BrewManagerPlugin): add empty state view for the Installed tab
  • feat(BrewManagerPlugin): add refresh toolbar item and rename about view
  • feat(BrewManagerPlugin): replace tab content with error view on failure
  • feat(conversation): inherit settings from previous conversation when creating new one
  • feat(ConversationListPlugin): hide toolbar button when chat section is hidden
  • feat(ConversationTitlePlugin): derive placeholder title from first message
  • feat(ConversationTitlePlugin): generate titles via background service
  • feat(GitPlugin): fall back to current project path when tool path is empty
  • feat(GitPlugin): resolve file and subdirectory paths to repository root in GitDiffTool
  • feat(KeychainKit): report read failures instead of collapsing them to missing
  • feat(layout): hover-aware rail divider with refined AppDivider width
  • feat(LLMKit): distinguish API key access failures from missing keys
  • feat(LLMProviderManagerPlugin): add sendDirect / generateText for non-turn LLM calls
